title: Frontend retired-mode gating and admin shutdown controls

requirements.summary: Show a single public "Site Retired" experience for all routes when the backend reports retired=true, while preserving normal behavior when active.
acceptanceCriteria: When the backend indicates retired=true, navigating to any existing route shows a single retired page with a clear English message (using the backend-provided public message if present).
When retired=true, primary navigation and tool entry points are not shown to non-admin users.
The retired screen does not require authentication to view.
If the backend is not retired, the app behaves exactly as before.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook that reads backend website status (via getWebsiteStatus) and exposes loading/error states for retired-mode gating. Use it as the single source of truth for retired vs active UI decisions.

Implement a public Site Retired screen that renders a clear shutdown message in English and displays the backend-provided public message when present. Compose existing shadcn/ui components (e.g., Card, Button) for layout and messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire retired-mode gating into the main Layout: if website status is retired and the caller is not an admin, render the SiteRetired screen instead of the normal routed content (Outlet) for all existing routes (/, /text-to-image, /text-to-video, /text-to-voiceover, /my-history, /admin). Ensure the gating does not require authentication and does not change behavior when active.

Hide primary navigation/tool links for non-admin users when the site is retired (based on website status). Keep admin navigation accessible for authenticated admins. Compose existing shadcn/ui components as needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add admin-only controls on the existing Admin page to retire the site and purge all user data with confirmation and clear error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin page shows controls to: (1) set the site to retired with an optional public message, and (2) purge all user data (only enabled/visible after retirement).
Both actions require an explicit confirmation (e.g., typing a confirmation phrase or a confirm dialog) before executing.
After successfully retiring the site, the UI reflects the new status without requiring a hard refresh.
Errors (e.g., non-admin, backend traps) are displayed to the admin in English via existing toast/error UI patterns.

file_operations.description: Add React Query mutations for admin actions that call backend retireWebsite(message | null), purgeData(), and (optionally) reactivateWebsite() to support admin testing. On success, invalidate the website status query so the UI updates without a hard refresh.

Extend the existing Admin page with a new shutdown controls section: (1) retire site with optional public message and explicit confirmation, and (2) purge all user data with explicit confirmation (visible/enabled only when status is retired). Use existing toast patterns for success/error messaging and reuse the existing isAdmin guard. Compose existing shadcn/ui components (Card, Input, Textarea, Button, etc.). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent neutral/gray shutdown theme for the retired screen and admin retirement section.
acceptanceCriteria: The retired screen and admin retirement section share consistent styling (colors, typography, spacing).
No blue/purple-dominant palette is introduced unless already present; use a neutral/gray-based theme appropriate for a shutdown notice.
All user-facing text shown in these new UI surfaces is in English.

file_operations.description: Add a small set of reusable, neutral/gray shutdown-related utility classes (e.g., for retired banners/surfaces and emphasis text) to ensure the Site Retired screen and Admin shutdown controls share consistent spacing and typography without introducing new blue/purple-dominant colors.

Apply the new neutral/gray shutdown styling consistently on the retired screen using existing Tailwind tokens/classes (and any added shutdown utility classes). Compose existing shadcn/ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Apply the same neutral/gray shutdown styling to the new admin retirement/purge controls section so it visually matches the retired screen, while keeping the rest of the admin editor unchanged. Compose existing shadcn/ui components. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
